_comment: Staging vocabulary the script writer may use. Keep in sync with engine/blender/abs_poses.py, abs_cat.py, abs_sets.py, scene.py (prop actions), engine/audio.py.

forest.notes: Sunny forest clearing with pine trees and a stream behind the action area. Host stands at 'host' (left). Props stand on anchors: center (main spot, right of the host), left, right, back (by the stream), front.

studio.notes: Plain warm cream backdrop. Use when the topic has no natural place, or to showcase objects/inventions. Same anchors as forest.

cozy_room.notes: Cozy room: host stands left of a window seat. Props stand on center/left/right (floor) or back (on the window seat). Only if the episode has the cat: the cat lives on the window seat (bench_*); 'cat', 'cat_low' follow it, 'two' frames host + bench_edge, pet_front + look 88 strokes a cat at bench_edge.

kitchen.notes: Bright home kitchen (counter, sink, stove, fridge, window). Cooking, food science, chemistry at home, everyday stuff.

classroom.notes: School classroom with a big green chalkboard, teacher desk, bookshelf. Maths, language, history lessons, study tips, 'did you know' facts.

park.notes: City park lawn with a path, bench, lamp post, round trees, blue sky. Outdoor everyday topics, sports, weather, animals in town, people.

desert.notes: Sunny desert with sand dunes and distant pyramids. Ancient history (Egypt, Mesopotamia), deserts, heat, survival, archaeology.

beat_fields.shot: one shot name, or use 'shots': [a, b] to split the beat
beat_fields.focus: prop id that prop/prop_close/two/card shots frame from this beat on (default: first prop)
beat_fields.prop: {"<prop id>": action} actions starting this beat: appear (pops in; it is hidden before), hide, show, spin, bob, wiggle, still
beat_fields.cat: only with the cat: {action, at (anchor, teleports - only on a cut), to (anchor, walks there), speed, face, head, trap_at}
beat_fields.card: BIG title text shown at the start of the beat (2-3 words, caps)
beat_fields.label: short caption box under the subtitles for the whole beat (<= 24 chars)
beat_fields.title: opening title (first beat only)

episode_fields.set: one of the sets above (pick what fits the topic)
episode_fields.props: list of things to show. Generated 3D object: {"id": "mill", "describe": "visual description of ONE object for an image generator", "at": anchor, "height": metres (host is 1.55), "yaw": degrees}. The procedural cat is the string "cat" (only for cat topics). Max 4 generated props.

shot_notes.card: focused prop from a high 3/4 angle
shot_notes.ots: over the host's shoulder onto the focused prop (host looks at it)
shot_notes.low: worm's-eye low angle up at host + prop (dramatic, scale)
shot_notes.host_low: low angle on the host (confident moments)
shot_notes.ecu: extreme close-up of the host's face (reactions, punchlines)
shot_notes.top: top-down map view of the focused prop - use with beat arrows for physics/flow explanations
shot_notes.side: profile view of the focused prop (cross-sections, flow through it)
shot_notes.orbit: slow arc around the focused prop (reveals)
shot_notes.establish: high far shot of the whole environment (openers, location changes)
shot_notes.reverse: from behind the stage looking back at the host
